entities.name: Mirko Petrović-Njegoš
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirko Petrović-Njegoš was a Montenegrin military commander, politician and poet, belonging to the House of Petrović-Njegoš. He was given the title of veliki vojvoda of Grahovo, and is thus also known as Vojvoda Mirko. He was the father of Nikola, the future ruler of Montenegro.
